name: birthday-gifting-app
description: Birthday & gifting platform — never forget a birthday, never guess the perfect gift.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bday/shared && npm run build -w @bday/api && npm run build -w @bday/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @bday/api && npm run lint -w @bday/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bday/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bday/api && npm run typecheck -w @bday/admin
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @bday/shared && npm run db:generate
